name: Prepare an FDA cosmetics listing packet
goal: Read Shopify product records, apply the shared reader and MoCRA rules checker to the brand-confirmed details, prepare a local SPL ZIP and deadline reminders, and leave signing and submission to the brand.

config.prompt: Your step: Review every field and source in the prepared packet. Confirm the ingredients and exemption checklist, then sign where required and upload the named SPL ZIP to FDA Cosmetics Direct. You submit the listing to FDA; Glacier has not signed or submitted anything.

acceptance.cmd: python -c "import json,os,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path(os.environ['GLACIER_HOME'])/'ventures'/'fda-cosmetics'/'packets'/'shopify-listing-summary.json'; d=json.loads(p.read_text()); assert d['submitted'] is False and all(x.get('result') in ('match','uncertain — please check') for x in d['products'])"
